risk_note: Admin console user detail relations (apps/admin pages/users; RV1, no money logic). Contract CT-24e (adminListInvitees, adminChangeUserLevel, adminChangeInviter; planned, backend not done, developed against the contract with a fake server) plus adminGetUser; visuals per design/specs/admin-user-detail.md. Relations card (当前上级) and invitees drawer loaded on open (paging, states, masked phones, row link to the user); level and inviter dialogs by permission point (user.level / user.inviter), required reason within the contract limit, step-up through the existing component then a single write, refresh from the returned user, 20001 next to the level, 30409 explanation only, 30401 / 30403 keep input. Frozen admin-users scope / permission assertions synced first by test-changes F1-06zp (#1073) and F1-06zq (#1078). Rule tests by Codex in two calls; Claude spec-test review r2 pass; red on the test machine (red/2: 38 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine browser/2 green and verify-fast/4 green after the rebase. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34 / 36). Written by hand.
